title: The Slow Protocol
author: Juniper Oyelaran
blurb: Paloma Dravenmoor, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
